main.description: Resolve one AT-URI record into the data needed to render an enhanced external embed. The records are validated against the requested `url` before any view is built. When validation passes, returns `data`, `associatedRefs` (strongRefs to embed into a post's external.associatedRefs) and the raw `associatedRecords`, plus a legacy `view` for Standard.site records only. When validation fails, only `unverifiedAssociatedRefs` and `unverifiedAssociatedRecords` are returned and no view or data is built. The response is empty (`{}`) when no record URI was usable or the record could not be resolved; clients should fall back to their own link-card rendering in that case and skip writing strongRefs to the post.

url.description: The canonical web URL the embed represents (typically the URL the user pasted into the composer). Used as the returned view's `uri`, and validated against the resolved records.

canonicalUri.description: The canonical AT URI of the atproto record found on the webpage. When provided, takes precedence over `uris`, which is then ignored.

uris.description: Legacy input for Standard.site callers, ignored when `canonicalUri` is provided. A single record is selected from it: the first site.standard.document URI, otherwise the first site.standard.publication URI. Other entries are ignored; a document's publication is discovered from the document itself.

view.description: Legacy hydrated view of the embed, returned for Standard.site records only. Present only when validation passed and the records supply enough information to populate the required `viewExternal` fields.

data.description: Preferred to #view. Hydrated data of the embed. Present only when validation passed and the records supply enough information to populate the required fields.

associatedRefs.description: StrongRefs (URI+CID) of the Atmosphere records resolved from the canonical record, suitable for embedding into a post's external.associatedRefs. Present only when validation passed. Index-aligned with `associatedRecords`.

items.description: The raw record data of the Atmosphere records resolved from the canonical record, index-aligned with `associatedRefs`. Returned for convenience, to avoid the client separately fetching them. Present only when validation passed.

unverifiedAssociatedRefs.description: StrongRefs (URI+CID) of the Atmosphere records resolved from the canonical record when validation of the requested `url` failed. These must not be written to a post. Index-aligned with `unverifiedAssociatedRecords`.

items.description: The raw record data of the Atmosphere records resolved from the canonical record, index-aligned with `unverifiedAssociatedRefs`. Present only when validation failed.
